description: Regression limits for actual first-party assets referenced by every public sitemap page in a production build. Deterministic gzip level 9 sizes; legacy noModule JavaScript is measured separately. This is not a Core Web Vitals pass or a loading-time guarantee.

headroom.bundles: 20% above the measured baseline, rounded up to the next KiB. This allows small maintenance changes while requiring review for material growth or framework upgrades.
headroom.portrait: 10% above the compressed source baseline, rounded up to the next KiB. Replacing the portrait requires keeping source compression comparable.
headroom.scope: Initial first-party scripts and styles only. Runtime lazy chunks, fonts, third-party widgets and browser execution time need separate browser/Lighthouse and field measurements. Limits must be reviewed deliberately, never automatically raised by CI.
